sources.title: StarVector
sources.snippet: Figure 1: StarVector is a foundation model for SVG generation. It uses a Vision-Language Modeling architecture to understand images and text instructions. StarVector excels at vectorizing a wide range of visual inputs, from general icons and logotypes to more intricate vectors such as technical diagrams.
